m1.typescript: m1 the permission rules let an explorer read search and take notes but not change the source

e1.typescript: e1 a read rule protects secrets from reading searching and writing

e2.typescript: e2 only rule forms that are consulted are used and no whole tool that changes things is allowed

e3.typescript: e3 the explorer agent reads and searches and says when to use it

e4.typescript: e4 the sdk options make the search tools available and remove the tools that change things

e5.typescript: e5 the exploration plan starts with a search then reads and never reads everything first

e6.typescript: e6 the edit fallback widens the anchor then replaces all then rewrites the file

e7.typescript: e7 no file holds a personal path an address or a key

wrong-no-src-deny.defect: drops the denial of edits under src

wrong-bash-bare.defect: allows the whole Bash tool instead of read-only git patterns

wrong-notes-everywhere.defect: allows edits to every path instead of notes only

wrong-write-rule.defect: writes the notes rule for the Write tool, whose path rules are never matched

wrong-no-env-deny.defect: drops the denial of reading the environment file

wrong-grep-rule.defect: writes the secrets rule for Grep instead of Read

wrong-agent-edit.defect: gives the explorer the Edit tool

wrong-agent-bash.defect: gives the explorer the Bash tool

wrong-agent-no-use-when.defect: leaves the when-to-use sentence out of the description

wrong-agent-unbounded.defect: leaves the turn limit out of the agent

wrong-options-no-search.defect: lists only Read in tools, so the search tools are missing

wrong-options-no-disallow.defect: removes only Bash and leaves Edit and Write in the context

wrong-plan-read-first.defect: reads the entry points before any search

wrong-no-export-step.defect: traces usage by function name without listing exported names

wrong-fallback-rewrite-first.defect: rewrites the whole file before widening the anchor

wrong-fallback-no-replace-all.defect: leaves replace_all out of the remedies

wrong-home-path.defect: writes a personal home path into the plan

wrong-extra-permission-key.defect: adds a key to the permissions block that is not allow, ask or deny
